Dear Phil,

I would like to ask you what is the difference between empirical (marginal) reliability ("empirical_rxx") and marginal reliability ("marginal_rxx").  How are these coefficients are interpreted, in terms of what they represent?  And finally is this an appropriate way to report reliability within the IRT framework?

Thanks a lot for your amazing support

Nikos
